events.name: Bash
events.head: Check ancestry, origin/main, and mirror og tags
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -2; git merge-base --is-ancestor 757b2ecd 06f00427 && echo IN_06f; git merge-base --is-ancestor 757b2ecd 41b1fcac && echo IN_41b; git rev-parse --short origin/main; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/masterclass/?v=$(date +%s)" | grep -oE '<meta (property|name)="(og:title|og:description|description)"[^>]*>' ; curl -s "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site/masterclass/?v=$(date +%s)" | grep -oiE 'webinar|\$50M|refund|money-back' | sort | uniq -c
